question: What TOC removal did the photocatalytic ozonation of sulfamethoxazole with Pd/Cu-modified TiO2 and g-C3N4 reach?
rendered: The paper does not mention the TOC removal of sulfamethoxazole with Pd/Cu-modified TiO2 and g-C3N4. However, it mentions the ozone dose (TOD) required to remove sulfamethoxazole. For example, in MQ water, photocatalytic ozonation with (Pd/Cu)1%C3N4 caused complete SMX removal when TOD reached 17.7 mgO3/dm3.
